result_classifications.audit_note: Left-permutive sideways reconstruction and finite-horizon cone uniqueness are already formalized in Rule30Realization.lean and R30-20261023-7e9e6e. Retained strictly as Gate G1 formal adapter bridges.

Uniform 2^(k+1) central trace realization on L x R is the finite-horizon counterpart of Rule30Realization.realize and holds identically for all left-permutive rules (including controls 90, 150, 210). Not claimed as a novel prize contribution.

Proves that for EVERY infinite initial configuration x : Int -> Bool, the depth-2 center observation evolG g x 2 0 of all three counterexample rules in Rule30Realization (g90, g150, and nonlinear g210) factors through a 1-bit right-half bottleneck, with x 0 cancelling identically in g210 via x0 && !x0 = false.

Proves on Rule30Realization.evol that a localized Mode A wavefront (false, true) at (p, p+1) absorbs x(p+2) at time t+1 and shields columns p-1 and p at time t+2, and separates g30 from g90, g150, g210.

result_classifications.audit_note: Establishes exact recurrence, signed discrepancy, sublinear envelope sufficiency (g4_p2_sublinear_rate_implies_problem2), and black/white partition identities for Rule30Prize.blackCount, and proves that ModeADepth w ell forces double-black neighbors (true, true) on columns (-1, +1) across the interior of every locked white run.

Formalizes the single-bit perturbation operator flipInput and the 2-step block-composition operator evolBlock2 on Rule30Realization.evol, proving causal light-cone locality [-t, +t], universal left-edge sensitivity for all x and t, active right-edge sensitivity at +t, and exact 2-step macro-block evaluation evolBlock2 x k p = evol x (2 * k) p.

Establishes (G5-P1) the universal monus transition law ModeADepth (w + r) (ell - r) after any white run of length r and the clipped-depth observational equivalence theorem reducing hAlign to the finite state space {0, ..., k + 1}; (G5-P2) exact run-based discrepancy formulas (-r on white runs, +b on black runs, +(b - r) on cycles) and formal falsification of per-cycle cancellation at w = 2; and (G5-P3) the recursive operator-doubling hierarchy evolPow2 d = evol (2^d) and its universal left-edge sensitivity across all doubling scales.
